I'm working out which requirements changed: none were added, and the revised tasks are the frontend and QA ones. The backend task citing R-8007d6b5 isn't marked for revision, so I'll leave it, though its sort parameter may be missing title. I'm weighing whether to note that as an edge case in the story and whether the backend acceptance criteria should allow sorting by title.

I'm settling the story's sort options to creation date, due date, status, priority and title, and I'm noting that sort direction and title case sensitivity are still unspecified. I'm also drafting the revised frontend task, a medium-sized one with five sort options that consumes the API but doesn't touch the database, and a small QA task covering both requirements.
